generation.speaker: dave
generation.scope: Actual pinned Python loader plus one existing-script utterance. Not listening quality, full render or production approval.

resources.rss_limit_scope: 25ms sampled PPid-tree stop threshold, not a kernel memory guarantee

setup_scope: Isolated workspace venv and public canonical assets; no CUDA wheels, services, host settings or production assets changed. Existing model variant and existing speaker assignments retained.
inference_network: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 and socket.socket.connect raises during actual loader/synthesis. Setup downloads were completed separately.

coverage: immutable revision supplied for every model/config/voice download
verified model paths and voice tensors reach loader
changed model revision or asset hashes prevent cached take reuse
existing speaker assignment, timing, audio integrity and no truncation tests

limitations: Short synthetic utterance only; no naturalness or prosody approval.
No complete episode regeneration, caption alignment or production replacement.
Sampled memory threshold is not a kernel memory guarantee; CPU-time limit is per process.
Exact runtime versions recorded for compatibility evidence; transitive dependencies are not newly locked by this change.
